tha-ap83:1.1: Nāgasamālavaggo aṭṭhamo. [IX. TIMIRAPUPPHIYA.] [81. Timirapupphiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre anusotaṃ vajām' ahaṃ / nisinnaṃ samaṇaṃ disvā vippasannam anāvilaṃ. // //
tha-ap83:2.1: Tassa cittaṃ pasādetvā evaṃ cintes' ahaṃ tadā / tārayissati tiṇṇo 'yaṃ danto 'yaṃ damayissati. // //
tha-ap83:3.1: Assāsessati assattho santo ca samayissati / mocayissati mutto ca nibbāpessati nibbuto. // //
tha-ap83:4.1: Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna Siddhatthassa mahesino / gahetvā timiraṃ pupphaṃ matthake okirim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap83:5.1: Añjalippaggahetvāna katvāna ca padakkhinaṃ / vanditvā satthuno pāde pakkāmiṃ aparaṃ disaṃ. // //
tha-ap83:6.1: Aciraṃ gatamattaṃ maṃ migarājā apīḷayi / papātam anugacchanto tatth' eva papatiṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap83:7.1: Catunavut' ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapujāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap83:8.1: Chappaññāsamhi kappamhi satt' ev' āsuṃ mahāyasā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap83:9.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap83:10.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Timirapupphiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
